---
title: "Fixed 26-week death — supporting analysis (5 imputations)"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This computationally reduced supporting analysis creates five independent
completions of 182-day vital status and fits the unadjusted binary death model
in each completed dataset. For participants censored before day 182, status is
drawn conditionally from the dedicated vital-status survival model fitted for
the QoL analysis.

```{r}
#| label: impute-and-fit-fixed-death
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
qol_artifact_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life"
)
prepared_path <- file.path(qol_artifact_dir, "prepared.parquet")
vital_status_model_path <- file.path(
  qol_artifact_dir,
  "vital-status-model.rds"
)
output_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-fixed-26-week-death"
)
result_dir <- here::here(
  "results", "supporting", "os-fixed-26-week-death"
)
imputation_path <- file.path(output_dir, "imputations.rds")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

create_imputations <- force || !file.exists(imputation_path)
if (create_imputations) {
  prepared <- arrow::read_parquet(prepared_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  diagnosis_levels <- unique(prepared$diagnosis_group[
    order(prepared$diagnosis_code)
  ])
  prepared$diagnosis_group <- factor(
    prepared$diagnosis_group,
    levels = diagnosis_levels
  )
  prepared$gender <- factor(prepared$gender)
  prepared$age_scaled <- scale(prepared$age)
  vital_status_model <- readRDS(vital_status_model_path)

  unresolved <- prepared$event_death == 0L &
    prepared$survival_time_days < config$analysis$horizon_days
  completed_datasets <- vector("list", length(indices))

  for (position in seq_along(indices)) {
    index <- indices[[position]]
    death_182 <- prepared$event_death
    conditional_survival <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(prepared))

    if (any(unresolved)) {
      predicted_survival <- rstanarm::posterior_survfit(
        vital_status_model,
        newdata = prepared[unresolved, ],
        type = "surv",
        times = config$analysis$horizon_days,
        condition = TRUE,
        last_time = "survival_time_days",
        standardise = FALSE,
        extrapolate = FALSE,
        draws = 1L,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 2600L),
        return_matrix = TRUE
      )
      conditional_survival[unresolved] <- as.numeric(
        predicted_survival[[1L]][1L, ]
      )
      set.seed(analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 2700L))
      death_182[unresolved] <- stats::rbinom(
        n = sum(unresolved),
        size = 1L,
        prob = 1 - conditional_survival[unresolved]
      )
    }

    completed_datasets[[position]] <- data.frame(
      id = prepared$id,
      tx = prepared$tx,
      death_182 = death_182,
      conditional_survival = conditional_survival,
      imputation = index,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  saveRDS(completed_datasets, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
} else {
  completed_datasets <- readRDS(imputation_path)
}

for (position in seq_along(indices)) {
  index <- indices[[position]]
  model_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  draws_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  draws_complete <- file.exists(draws_path) &&
    nrow(arrow::read_parquet(draws_path)) ==
      config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws
  if (
    !create_imputations && !force &&
      file.exists(model_path) && draws_complete
  ) {
    next
  }

  data <- completed_datasets[[position]]
  if (!create_imputations && !force && file.exists(model_path)) {
    model <- readRDS(model_path)
  } else {
    model <- rstanarm::stan_glm(
      death_182 ~ tx,
      data = data,
      family = binomial(),
      chains = 4L,
      iter = 1000L,
      warmup = 500L,
      cores = 4L,
      seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 2800L)
    )
    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }

  posterior <- as.matrix(model)
  set.seed(analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 2900L))
  posterior <- posterior[
    sample.int(
      nrow(posterior),
      config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  intercept <- posterior[, "(Intercept)"]
  treatment <- posterior[, "tx"]
  draws <- data.frame(
    draw = seq_len(config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws),
    death_risk_control = stats::plogis(intercept),
    death_risk_intervention = stats::plogis(intercept + treatment),
    death_risk_difference = stats::plogis(intercept + treatment) -
      stats::plogis(intercept),
    imputation = index,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  arrow::write_parquet(draws, draws_path, compression = "zstd")
}

draws <- do.call(rbind, lapply(indices, function(index) {
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    output_dir,
    sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  )) |>
    as.data.frame()
}))
summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(draws$death_risk_difference)
summary$imputations <- length(indices)
summary$posterior_draws_per_imputation <-
  config$imputation$supporting$post_estimation_draws
summary$computationally_reduced <- TRUE

arrow::write_parquet(
  draws,
  file.path(result_dir, "draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  as.data.frame(summary),
  file.path(result_dir, "summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```
